title: Point-finite covers of closed subsets admit closure-subordinate shrinkings
statement: Let $X$ be a paracompact Hausdorff topological space, where paracompact means that every open cover admits a locally finite open refinement. Let $S\subseteq X$ be closed, with its subspace topology [def-kun-subspace-topology], let $I$ be a set, and let $(W_a)_{a\in I}$ be open subsets of $X$ covering $S$. Assume the cover is point-finite on $S$, meaning that $\{a\in I:x\in W_a\}$ is finite for every $x\in S$. Then there are open subsets $(V_a)_{a\in I}$ of $X$ such that $S\subseteq\bigcup_{a\in I}V_a$ and $\overline{V_a}\subseteq W_a$ for every $a\in I$, where the closure is taken in $X$.
